proposed_widenings.name: EquipmentPredicate.touching_item
proposed_widenings.justification: The item is enabled by physical contact with the orb, which is narrower than the current held/worn predicates and should be authorable without lying about the gate.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While touching this crystal orb, you can cast Scrying (save DC 17) with it.

proposed_widenings.name: grant_spell_access lifecycle override tied to another granted spell
proposed_widenings.justification: The Detect Thoughts rider needs two linked behaviors the current surface cannot express: waiving concentration for that cast, and ending that cast when the paired Scrying cast ends.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You don't need to concentrate on this Detect Thoughts spell to maintain it during its duration, but it ends if the Scrying spell ends.

notes: Did not author content JSON or trace. The item fits the existing magic-item kind, and spell-sensor target restriction already exists, but the touch gate and cross-spell lifecycle override are missing from the surface.
